description: Find places around coordinates. Groups: outdoors, heritage, family, all. Opening hours and accessibility are unverified source data. Results include source attribution and public DalVivo URLs.

cursor.description: Opaque page.next_cursor from the previous call with the same arguments. Omit for the first page.

group.description: outdoors: parks, viewpoints, gardens, lakes, waterfalls, peaks, mountain huts. heritage: museums, castles, monuments, galleries. family: zoos, aquariums, theme and adventure parks, water parks, planetariums. all (default): every type.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS 84) of the search centre, e.g. from resolve_location.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS 84) of the search centre, e.g. from resolve_location.

radius_m.description: Search radius in straight-line metres from lat/lng, 1000 to 100000. Default 30000 (30 km).

name: search_places
title: Cerca luoghi
